main.description: Middle-schema instance mediating between two records related by a symmetric lens. Updated whenever either side changes to maintain coherence.

symmetricLens.description: AT-URI of the symmetric lens this state belongs to.

leftRecord.description: AT-URI of the current left-side record.

rightRecord.description: AT-URI of the current right-side record.

leftHash.description: Content hash of the left record at last sync.

rightHash.description: Content hash of the right record at last sync.

objectHash.description: Content hash of the middle-state blob.

blob.description: The middle-schema instance that mediates between left and right.
